reuse.why: Introduces one guard and calls it from every existing link function, using the tree's db.first query helper.

duplication.why: The duplicate-link check is written once; each link function only passes its provider, account id and upgradingId.

placement.why: The guard sits in accounts/app.ts next to the link handlers, though accounts/link.ts already holds shared link helpers like findOrCreateBank and would be the more natural home.

scope.why: Only the guard and its five call sites are added.

maintainability.why: A single, clearly named guard with a minimal query is easy to own; each new provider still has to remember to call it because the link functions themselves remain per-provider copies.

one_place.where: accounts/app.ts ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked, called at the top of all five provider link functions (goCardless, simpleFin, pluggyai, akahu, enableBanking)
